title: BAGMAN Contract Schema Version
description: BAGMAN's canonical contract-version identifier string, per PID §17. Format: `bagman.<domain>.v<N>`, e.g. `bagman.evidence.v1`, `bagman.audit_event.v1`, `bagman.entity.v1`. `<domain>` is a lowercase, underscore-separated token naming the contract's domain; `<N>` is a positive integer contract version, incremented for breaking changes (a breaking change ships as a new file/version, e.g. `v2`, alongside the prior version — the prior version is never edited in place). This primitive is referenced by name from any contract that needs to self-declare its own schema version (e.g. the `schema_version` field on `AuditEvent`), and by convention its value for a given schema equals that schema's own version identifier.
